fields.statement: At 3b5eb86c, with the built binary in a scratch root: rhiza root init <root>, cd <root>, rhiza project add <root>/myapp registers the project (from outside the root it still fails, as the doc now warns). run start <change> --workflow ship-change --dry-run without --permission-mode stops asking for one, even with rhiza.daemon.permissionMode set; with --permission-mode acceptEdits it prints the run; bypassPermissions is refused without trust = "dedicated" in machine.toml, as the doc says. daemon settings shows plan=owner and accept/ship/signoff=auto, matching the Autonomy section. A workflow copied with workflow new mine --from ship-change plus an [autonomy] table (signoff, ship = owner) passes workflow check, and run start --workflow mine --permission-mode acceptEdits --dry-run prints ship and signoff as 'owner from workflow mine', the rest from rhiza.autonomy.<stage>. run request-changes <file> [<run>] matches the doc. Every rhiza command the page names answers --help; internal/doclinks passes.

At 3b5eb86c, with the built binary in a scratch project: rhiza workflow new bugfix, then the doc's cat > .rhiza/workflows/bugfix.toml heredoc; rhiza workflow check bugfix says valid (exit 0), workflow describe bugfix shows reproduce -> fix -> test (fail -> fix) -> ci as described, and run start --workflow bugfix --dry-run with a current change set prints the run. The [ready] bug = "bugfix" dispatch.toml is accepted. The reference is named as the plain path docs/reference/workflow-file.md, per decision custom-workflow-doc-reference-plain-path. TestScripts/custom-workflows-doc and internal/doclinks pass.
At 3b5eb86c, with the built binary: every rhiza command named in docs/agents.md answers --help, and internal/doclinks TestRepoDocsLinksResolve passes on its links.
